mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 10.0% indicate a weak labor market, prompting central bank stimulus and fiscal support that boost equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 10.0

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both HOUST and RSAFS above their 50th percentile) fails to predict positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production following a recession indicates improving economic activity, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in the post-recession recovery regime.
failure_condition: In the post-recession industrial recovery regime (INDPRO growth > 0.5% MoM for 3 consecutive months), 5d forward returns are negative in > 50% of cases

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation above 215.0 (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS) reflects expanding labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during labor market expansion.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between PAYEMS growth and 60d SPX returns breaks down (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP and housing starts indicates broad-based economic strength, accelerating corporate earnings momentum and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in strong growth regimes.
failure_condition: The joint signal (GDPC1 growth > 1.0% YoY and HOUST > 580) fails to predict positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases

mechanism_narrative: Ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) create a favorable environment for equity valuations by compressing discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in the ultra-low rate regime.
failure_condition: In the ultra-low interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), 5d forward returns are negative in > 50% of cases
